endpoint_contract.primary: Eligible F0 derived integer allocations totaling10000 units (100.00%) using unchanged accepted exact arithmetic; retain missing/unfinalizable F0 as missing with explicit reason.
endpoint_contract.raw_companion: Report original D0/F0 weight vectors, exact sums, bounds/schema errors, citation availability, factual/source interpretation and explanation consistency separately. Raw artifacts and original r2 analysis never change.
endpoint_contract.math: Positive finite complete11 nonnegative vector -> proportional normalization with exact rational arithmetic -> largest-remainder10000 integer units and fixed GICS order tie break. Reject missing/nonfinite/negative/all-zero vectors. Disclose material rescaling versus displayed rounding.
endpoint_contract.semantic: Assess claimed values and claimed changes against the raw submitted vector first; separately identify normalization/quantization changes to comparator direction, concentration and ties. Mechanical100% does not demonstrate model feedback use or semantic correctness.
endpoint_contract.precedence: The original frozen phrase never normalized remains true of saved raw model artifacts. A distinct user-directed amended endpoint applies external math uniformly to eligible vectors; do not call it prespecified raw accuracy.
endpoint_contract.evaluation: Original v4.9.2 r2 semantic dimensions and descriptive raw diagnostics remain; no composite success score.

claims_and_limits: Five logical conditions across sequential segments are descriptive cases, not independent replicated trials. Sector rows, turns and repeated AI reviews do not increase independent sample size.
Evidence timing, source, order, service session, elapsed time and operational standby/AC mitigation are not separately identified; do not claim causal effects.
No investment recommendation, future-return prediction or portfolio-performance claim.
Masking is partial; use fresh AI readers with only actual opaque item when available and disclose source clues, AI assistance and lack of independent human validation.
Existing observed output/audit exposure and later protocol amendment prevent a fully preregistered confirmatory framing.

user_authorization.scope: Finish only the five never-attempted remaining slots. No new Q3/July main execution, no replacement D0, no automatic retry.

remaining_stage_rules.stops: Cancellation, instrument integrity failure, unsafe/unknown power state, stale or missing review acknowledgement and transport-system failure stop progression. Completed, failed and unattempted slots remain visible.
remaining_stage_rules.ordinary_model_errors: Raw sum/bounds/citation/source interpretation/explanation failures are observations. They are not success gates, retry triggers or grounds to omit results.
remaining_stage_rules.generation_budget: At most five new requests; at most eleven across all four segments, including the original failed Fidelity L D0.

external_semantic_review_barrier.before: Before the next model request and before normal final attempt-sequence completion; no generation while awaiting acknowledgement.
external_semantic_review_barrier.completion: Acknowledgement status completed, exact case/stage and input hashes, semantic review_status completed with same transport_ref; all errors/consistency/paper_topic axes reviewed with nonempty reasons. Failed or unavailable output is reviewed as failed/unavailable, never invented.
external_semantic_review_barrier.no_quality_threshold: Negative arithmetic/citation/factual/semantic findings and unresolved interpretations are allowed. Audit completion is required; a finding-free result, semantic PASS, hypothesis confirmation or normalized-vector existence is not.
external_semantic_review_barrier.model_feedback: The external audit, math sidecar and reviewer observations never enter model messages or calculator feedback; original frozen own-D0 feedback remains the only feedback.
external_semantic_review_barrier.failure: Missing acknowledgement for1800 seconds, cancellation, stale/malformed refs or system-integrity issue stops progression and preserves all completed/failed/unattempted stages. No retry or extra generation.
external_semantic_review_barrier.operational_change: The same reviewed per-stage completion barrier continues for only the five remaining slots. The completed inherited D0 ACK is bound and validated without issuing a replacement audit-dependent prompt.
